source.transition: shared residual MLP: s=mean(visual_proj)+proprio_proj+action_proj; predicted native latent feedback each step
source.teacher_target: shared detached official DINO-WM rollout target
source.baseline: read-only query-slate latent-MSE control from supplied summary
source.observation_encoder: outside scope; cached native observation latent

slate.primary: exact logged action prefix from the selected manifest context
slate.distinctness: exact tensor equality validated before step 1; collision invalidates run

schedule.generation: fresh CPU permutation of 0..255 every 32 updates; consume eight consecutive ordinals

architecture_effect.interpretation: descriptive architecture contrast against a completed read-only baseline; not same-initialization causal evidence

claim_boundary.architecture_effect: A predictor-level architecture contrast against the completed query-slate control under the shared frozen schedule; it is not same-initialization causal evidence.
claim_boundary.full_replacement: Only if all frozen recurrent gates pass, including absolute fidelity, logged-action non-inferiority, causality, and latency.

timing_boundary: predictor-level: cached native observation latent plus normalized action prefix; excludes encode_obs, CEM execution, environment interaction and closed-loop control
unverified: No closed-loop CEM or environment execution is included
